items.program_name: 雇用創出税額控除(OH JCTC)
items.summary: Ohio Tax Credit AuthorityがThe Technology House社(Streetsboro/Solon)に対し、雇用創出税額控除(JCTC)を8年間1.446%で承認。72人の新規雇用と年間$5,362,440の新規給与創出が条件。
items.infer: 受託製造・試作(ラピッドプロトタイピング)関連企業とみられ、新規雇用拡大に伴い設備投資が進む可能性(推論)。
items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a Job Creation Tax Credit of 1.446% for 8 years on 2026-04-27 for a project in the City of Streetsboro, Portage County and in the City of Solon, Cuyahoga County.
